question: Qual o valor total recebido por tipo de meio de pagamento considerando apenas pedidos entregues?
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    op.payment_type, 
    ROUND(SUM(op.payment_value), 2) AS total_paid 
FROM marts.fct_order_payments op 
JOIN marts.fct_orders o 
    ON op.order_id = o.order_id 
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' 
GROUP BY op.payment_type 
ORDER BY total_paid DESC;
